title: Finite locally constant coefficient modules are constructible
statement: For any scheme X and commutative Noetherian coefficient ring R in the independent coefficient universe, any module sheaf F over the constant ring on the coefficient-sized etale site that is locally constant with finite-type values in the slice sense of [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules] is constructible in the fixed-scalar affine-stratification sense of [def-pe-etale-constructible-module].

source.place: Tag 03RW(3), finite locally constant implies constructible

proof.text: Restrict scalar actions along the constant-section unit. The sheafification unit identifies the resulting constant module-valued sheaf with the usual constant sheaf: its underlying map is locally injective and locally surjective, and hence its sheafification is an isomorphism. This restriction commutes with over-object restriction, so the given local finite module models yield fixed-scalar locally constant finite models.

On every affine open choose the one-stratum stratification with whole-space constructible stratum, domain that open, and identity immersion. Inverse image along the affine open immersion preserves the fixed-scalar finite local systems, giving the constructibility condition. This works also for empty affine opens.
